airflow_restriction.reasonable_recommendation: Inspect filter, damper, and upstream airflow path before escalating to chiller equipment.

high_energy.reasonable_recommendation: Review load profile and equipment duty cycle for abnormal energy draw.

high_temperature.reasonable_recommendation: Inspect cooling loop and validate sensor accuracy before repair actions.

pressure_anomaly.reasonable_recommendation: Check for damper restriction, filter blockage, and pressure control instability.

required_evidence: sensor value loss or impossible range
airflow or temperature outside expected envelope
alert pattern inconsistent with normal operations
sensor_failure.reasonable_recommendation: Validate sensor health, calibration, and connection integrity before acting on downstream asset conditions.
